more_cautious_if: Debt is lower than shareholders' equity (debt-to-equity 0.44)
Free cash flow is 19.1% of the market value, a solid cash return
Return on capital employed is 16.0%, a strong return on the money in the business
notes: the ceiling is 10.0% of a portfolio: risk per position divided by the volatility-based stop distance, capped by your single-stock limit

prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow is 19.1% of the market value, a solid cash return. Also in its favour: return on capital employed is 16.0%, a strong return on the money in the business; and debt is lower than shareholders' equity (debt-to-equity 0.44). Other areas on this side: the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 33.0% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 30.2 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; the share price is 42% below its 52-week high; and profit fell 53% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, cash flow and the balance sheet, price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 3 points in favour and 12 against give more points against. The pool score is 42 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Underweight with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
